plainTranslation: A's growth meets B's drive. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility work smoothly with your drive, timing, and willingness to act. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The challenge is laziness. You can both see what is possible and still do nothing about it. You can talk about the dream, believe in the dream, and never take the step that makes it real.
advice: This connection becomes powerful when someone is willing to take the first step.
summaryShort: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility work smoothly with your drive, timing, and willingness to act.
